content.title: Virgo Horoscope for March 2026
content.text: Share Dear Reader, On the heels of one big month, we have another. Click here to read Susan's Monthly News Your March 2026 Horoscope for Virgo by Susan MillerA close relationship in love or business is becoming clearer in your mind. A full moon lunar eclipse is due on March 3 in Virgo at 13 degrees, and full moon eclipses are strong. They bring endings, closures, and final chapters. Alternatively, they can mark the end of one way of life and the beginning of another. With all lunar eclipses, something ends, and something else begins. Your view of a close relationship will become sharper and more defined. At the same time, your emotions will come to the surface with great force. Over the past three years (since March 2023), your serious close relationship in love or business has been tested by Saturn, who was challenging you and asking: Is this relationship a forever connection for you? Or do you actually want to leave? Not only did you have old Saturn pressing on you, but you also had a series of eclipses in Virgo and Pisces doing pretty much the same. The first eclipse in the Virgo and (opposite sign) Pisces series started on September 17, 2024. The following year, 2025, you had three more sensitive eclipse dates: March 13 (a lunar eclipse in Virgo), September 7 (a lunar eclipse in Pisces), and September 21 (a solar eclipse in Virgo—this was the only new moon solar eclipse in the entire series). Looking over these dates, one or two may stand out to you, and perhaps these are dates when something significant happened within eight days of the eclipse (this event may have also occurred one month to the day earlier or one month to the date later, plus one week).
